name: Shoal Creek Golf Course
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Gold, Blue. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: Not publishable as-is: holes 5 and 6 are the neighbouring course's holes (black pictures, no elevation, wrong yardage on 6 Blue). 15 holes OK, 1 OK with an estimated Gold tee (2).

2: Gold CHECK: no OSM box at 427, the Gold marker is walked back 32 yds behind the back OSM box on the hole line (428 measured). Blue on an OSM box at 396 vs 403.
4: 418/384 = card. rv16 rebuild (2026-11-02 QA): the Gold tee moved to lidar pad lidar:409 (39.2490648, -94.4742379), 76 yds from the Blue box and 66 yds off the hole line beside the hole-3 green, so the tee line crossed…
6: WRONG ROUTING. Same cause: the page's hole 6 is Hodge Park's 6 (OSM way 1565676852, 297 yds), outside the course, black picture, no elevation; Blue used a Hodge Park box (278 vs card 333).
